api: REST API and SDKs, plus Vertex AI for enterprise deployment with cloud-native controls.
cons: Product naming and tiering are genuinely confusing
Quality less consistent than its top peers on hard text tasks
Best value depends on already being a Google shop
name: Gemini
pros: Deepest Workspace integration of any assistant
Enterprise controls and data residency through Vertex AI
files: Broad multimodal input including text, images, audio, and video. Very large context windows on the higher tiers, which is one of its genuine differentiators.
value: The most natural choice for organizations already standardised on Google Workspace, because it reaches directly into Docs, Sheets, Gmail, and Drive rather than requiring content to be pasted into a separate tool.
engine: Google's proprietary Gemini model family. Not open weight.
latency: Fast on the lighter models, slower on the largest. Generally competitive.

pricing.includes: Advanced models, larger limits, storage bundle
In-app AI across Workspace, admin controls

quality: Strong multimodal handling and very long context. Quality across text tasks is competitive but not consistently ahead of its peers.
tagline: Google's assistant, strongest where the work already lives in Google Workspace.
use_cases: Summarising and drafting inside Gmail, Docs, and Sheets without leaving them
Analysing very large documents and long video or audio inputs
Building on Google Cloud through Vertex AI with existing IAM and data residency controls
training_optout: Enterprise Workspace and Vertex AI customer data is not used to train models. Consumer terms differ. As with ChatGPT, the tier distinction is where governance problems start.
